title: Oral rehabilitation / complex cases
description: Crowns, prosthetics, and heavily restored mouths. We coordinate with specialists when needed, prioritizing conservative and functional options.

items.name: Complex case evaluation
items.description: Full-mouth assessment with diagnostic records, written treatment plan with phases, timeline, and reference costs. Includes specialist coordination if needed.

items.name: Single zirconia crown
items.description: Premium zirconia crown for strength and natural appearance. Includes preparation, lab work, and fitting.

items.name: Bridge (per unit)
items.description: Fixed bridge to replace one or more missing teeth. Pricing varies with span and materials.

items.name: Implant crown (restoration only)
items.description: Placement of the final crown on an existing implant. The surgical placement is done by a specialist I coordinate with.

process: Comprehensive clinical exam and diagnostic records
Specialist consultation if needed (implants, surgery, perio)
Phased treatment plan with options at each stage

faqs.q: Will I need to see a specialist?
faqs.a: Possibly. If your case needs implants, surgery, or complex periodontal work, I refer to a specialist and coordinate the entire process. You don't have to manage it alone.

faqs.q: How long does full rehabilitation take?
faqs.a: It depends on the case. Simple cases take a few months. Complex cases with implants or surgery can take 6-12 months. The plan includes a realistic timeline.

faqs.q: What if I've been told I need everything extracted?
faqs.a: Bring the recommendation. I'll review the case with no conflict of interest. If extraction is genuinely the right call, I'll tell you. If something can be saved, I'll show you.
I restore implants (place the crown on top). Surgical placement is done by a maxillofacial specialist I work with. This separation keeps the surgical quality high.
